You see a plate armor (Arm:10).
Classification: 1 Tier: 0.
It weighs 120.00 oz.

    Notes

    This armor is used by mostly all players in lower levels, because it's easy to get and provides good defense. It is the next armor to get after Scale Armor.
    For a mage, the more suitable armor with same defense is a Mammoth Fur Cape. Knights should save for a noble or knight armor. Paladins should buy a Belted Cape which has the same defense but is much lighter. This can also be gotten by unrusting a Heavily Rusted Armor, Rusted Armor or Slightly Rusted Armor. Can be obtained in the Plate Armor Quest.
